## Frame approval workflow
Uses the supplied script unchanged. Generates a still frame, saves it, and stops at awaiting_approval. No video provider call before approval. Supports 5 or 10 second clips. Credentials stay in n8n.

nodes.name: Upsert Job Record
nodes.notes: Insert on first run. On regenerate the row exists and this 409s harmlessly - onError lets it pass through.

nodes.name: Read Job
nodes.notes: Authoritative read - gives us frame_attempt whether this is a first run or a regenerate.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ parts: [{ text: $('Prepare Prompt').item.json.frame_prompt + ($('Prepare Prompt').item.json.is_regenerate ? ' Vary the composition and lighting from previous attempts while keeping the same subject and setting.' : '') }] }], generationConfig: { responseModalities: ['IMAGE'], imageConfig: { aspectRatio: $('Prepare Prompt').item.json.aspect_ratio } } }) }}

nodes.name: Upload Frame to Storage
nodes.notes:
MUST use the legacy eyJ... JWT service role key. The sb_secret_... format breaks Storage uploads silently.
upsert:false + randomised filename avoids the UPDATE RLS policy.

nodes.notes: frame_approved_at is explicitly nulled - a regenerate must invalidate any prior approval.
